name: Newor Media
author: newormedia

sections.description:
Newor Media plugin simplifies the process of adding Newor Media ads to the WordPress blog.

Features and Advantages

  • Dynamic ads.txt file
    • Seamlessly automate the updating of ads.txt files, eliminating manual work and saving time
  • Automated header script
    • Allows for quick addition of header script to the site, no more manual placement
  • Automated sticky footer ad
    • Allows for quick insertion of sticky footer ads onsite
  • Automated interstitial ad
    • Allows for speedy insertion of interstitial ads onsite
  • Incontent ads
    • Easily add incontent, higher impact, and higher earnings units with speed and ease of use
sections.installation:
From within WordPress

  1. Visit ‘Plugins > Add New’
  2. Search for ‘Newor Media’
  3. Activate ‘Newor Media’ for WordPress from your ‘Plugins’ menu from WordPress.
  4. Visit the new ‘Newor Media’ menu to configure the ads.

Manually

  1. Upload the newormedia/ folder to the /wpcontent/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Visit the new ‘Newor Media’ menu to configure the ads.
sections.faq:
What does the Newor Media plugin do?

The Newor Media plugin streamlines the process of adding Newor Media ads to your WordPress site. It offers features like automatic updating of ads.txt, easy injection of header scripts, and support for multiple ad types including sticky footer, interstitial, and in-content ads.

How do I install the plugin on my WordPress site?

From within WordPress:

  1. Navigate to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for Newor Media.
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  4. Once activated, you’ll find a new Newor Media menu in your dashboard—click it to configure your ad settings.

Manual installation:

  1. Upload the newormedia/ folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate it from the Plugins page.
  3. Access the Newor Media settings for configuration.

Is the plugin compatible with my site setup?

Yes, the plugin is compatible with WordPress versions 5.3 and above and requires PHP 5.4 or higher.
For optimal performance, we recommend using the latest versions of both WordPress and PHP.

How can I reach support if I need help?

If you run into any issues with the plugin or have questions about your account, our team is here to help.
You can contact us directly at publishersupport@newormedia.com and we’ll get back to you as quickly as possible.
Whether it’s troubleshooting, setup guidance, or general questions about Newor Media, we’re just an email away.
